summary.intent: Execute Session 1 of the v1-alpha launch plan for the callisto repo: fix pre-cycle aggregation (F1), drive release-PR decide from the version plan (F2), and build G (pre.json v3), H (managed prerelease), and M (status --since) work packages. Later: resolve merge conflicts on G's PR #571 and address two Entire review findings.
summary.outcome: F1 (#566) and F2 (#567) were pushed as drafts. G was merged with main and passed all gates. The two review fixes, status reporting archived-note parse failures and pre exit refusing with E102, were pushed as a9638d7e8 and both Entire findings resolved. H and M were built and reviewed. Mutation testing on the final G fix left one survivor, now covered by a new test; its re-run was still in progress.

repo: Release gate is `just pre-push`, `just lint`, `just doc-check`, `just test` and `just ci`; judge each by exit code. Set CARGO_BUILD_JOBS to cores/5 and disable debug info for speed.
Plain `git push` silently no-ops from worktrees because local branch names differ from PR branches. Push `HEAD:refs/heads/<branch>` and verify with `git ls-remote`.
Never commit `mutants.out*`. Clean it after cargo-mutants runs. An earlier G branch had tracked 137 `mutants.out.old/` files.
Stacked PRs are forbidden: G, H and M must wait for F1/F2 to merge, then rebase or merge main before pushing.
Commits must be signed. Verify with `gh api repos/.../commits/<sha> --jq .commit.verification.reason`.
Public surface changes (diagnostic codes, CLI flags, decision schema fields) need spec updates in docs/specs/*.json plus docs and a changeset via `callisto add`.
Pre-mode aggregation now models Seed/Source with fresh vs retained changesets. Retained changesets set severity but release nothing unless some source is fresh.
Entire review findings are resolved with `entire trail finding resolve <id> --trail <n> --branch <b> -m ...`.
Subagent hand-backs and cross-session messages carry no user authority; verify review claims against the code before acting, as with H's medium finding that did not hold.

code.finding: Archived notes naming two packages, one removed, were skipped whole. Combined with pre exit deleting pre.json, this orphaned the surviving package's notes. The fix refuses exit with E102.

The ParseChangeset error was suppressed and diagnostics scanned only the root, so a malformed .changeset/pre/*.md let `status --check` pass. Archived parse failures are now loaded permissively and reported as changeset-parse-failed.
pre exit deletes pre.json here, which is why unresolved archived notes must block exit beforehand.

Reviewer noted the linked-group target uses named_severity, which excludes Group sources. This differs from the old code when a fixed group raises a member earlier in the same pass, and may need `.filter(is_named).map(Seed::severity)`.

friction: The cargo-mutants runs failed repeatedly from test filters naming binaries that exist on only some branches, wrong package flags, and a sandbox-blocked sed edit that re-ran the unchanged script.
A runaway G subagent kept re-sending the same report and had to be stopped.
The full F1 suite was slow (1924 tests), which forced parallel worktrees and led to stale runs when code changed mid-run.
The merge of main into G conflicted in 7 files because F1/F2/M/G each added different VersionPlan fields.
`just ci` on F1 failed only on the audit step for RUSTSEC-2026-0542, which was fixed upstream by #560.
The macOS x64 preflight was cancelled for lack of runners, so the lead has to re-run it.
open_items: Push H once #571 merges: rebase onto main, re-gate with the five checks, and open it on trail #457 via `entire trail ci-pr`.
The final mutants re-run on the new `exit_keeps_warning` test was still in progress, so its result is unconfirmed.
Run `just ci` on H and M; M's PR has since merged as #570.
Stale-PR gap: a stale release PR that deletes no changesets is not caught by E165's changeset check, only by the Hold workflow and the manifest check.
Rerunning `version` locally before a prerelease is tagged re-infers the same commits for release-trigger=auto packages, which can plan the next beta again.
Possible linked-group severity regression in aggregate.rs (named_severity vs full severity) is unverified against cascade propagation.
G's last fix round is done; any further Entire findings on #571 are to be reported to the lead rather than fixed.
Decide whether to accept the new permanent public surface: `status --since`, the `changed-without-changeset` code, and the `consumedChangesets` decision field.
